g.text: I was charged twice for invoice 4411.
For each option, mark Yes if it answers the question, otherwise No.
d = E[Yes] − E[No]: two rows of the model's output layer
h at the mask (6 of its 64 numbers)
a yes/no question, after the same system message and state, ends with one mask:
one forward pass gives the hidden state h at every mask; an option's score is the model's Yes logit minus its No logit there (the fixture's random numbers)
